title: Beyond Partisan Leaning: A Comparative Analysis of Political Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting 43 LLMs with persona-free, survey-style questions adapted from the American National Election Studies (ANES) and Pew Research Center. The evaluation measures partisan orientation on highly polarized topics using an Entropy-Weighted Bias Score (coding responses as Pro-Democrat, Pro-Republican, or Neutral) and assesses sociopolitical engagement on less polarized issues (e.g., climate change, foreign policy) using a 5-point scale and hierarchical clustering.
